record.question: The point you are raising is not _________ to the subject.
record.explanation: Answer A: pertinent. “Pertinent to the subject” means relevant to the subject. Independent check: “Pertinent to” means relevant to or connected with the subject; the other choices do not express that relation as directly. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/ablutophobia; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pertinent. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
